title: Abahamya Bazimiye
intro: Mu gihe cyashize, umuryango wabaga mu nzira y’ubutaka hagati y’ubwami. Umuhanuzi wabo yabahamagaye mu nzira y’ukuri, nyamara bakomeje kutemera no gukandamizwa. Iyi nkuru irangirana n’igihano cy’Imana. Ese ushobora kumenya iki gihugu n’iherezo ryacyo ukurikije ibimenyetso biri hepfo?
clues: Abantu banze umuburo wazanywe n'umwe mu ntumwa zabo.
Intumwa yaduhamagariye gusenga Allah wenyine kandi yatuburiye ku birebana no kwangirika.
Icyaha cyacu cyari ukwanga umuhanuzi woherejwe muri twe akiranuka.
Twashidikanyije ku bubasha bw'intumwa maze tuyishinja uburiganya.
Igihano cyatugezeho ubwo twari dutuye mu mazu yacu mu mutekano.
Twarimbuwe kubera guhakana umuhanuzi wacu no gutoteza abizera.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
